title: Project dropdown too narrow since the host filter: open list is half the session panel and cuts off paths
outcome: The open Project list spans the whole session panel, within its bounds, whatever the button's width, while the Project and Host controls can stay side by side.
acceptance: The open Project list is as wide as the session panel, stays inside it, and follows panel width changes; paths aren't cut off by the half-width button. A behaviour test or a recorded real-view check covers this.
There is no horizontal overflow, overlay and scrolling behave properly, and selecting by mouse and keyboard still works.
No extra queries and no performance regression. Review pair with no Medium or higher, and the normal checks and gate.

completion.summary: Landed Sessions Project list anchored across panel scope, responsive bounds/path wrapping, preserved mouse/keyboard/scroll behavior; real-App A/B and scoped tests recorded.
